name: io.github.mhajder/glpi-mcp
description: MCP server for GLPI IT service management (tickets, assets, users, knowledge base)
title: GLPI MCP

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_URL
environmentVariables.description: GLPI root URL without /api.php (e.g., https://glpi.example.com); needs GLPI 11.0.6+ or 12

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client ID from GLPI Setup > OAuth clients

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client secret from GLPI Setup > OAuth clients

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: GLPI user the tools act as (OAuth password grant)

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password of the GLPI user

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: OAuth scopes to request, space- or comma-separated (add graphql for GraphQL)

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_API_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: High-Level API version: auto, 2.3 or 3.0

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_ENTITY
environmentVariables.description: Entity ID to work in (GLPI-Entity header)

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_ENTITY_RECURSIVE
environmentVariables.description: Include sub-entities of GLPI_ENTITY

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Profile ID to work with (GLPI-Profile header)

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_VERIFY_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Verify SSL certificates

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Total seconds allowed for one request, retries included

environmentVariables.name: READ_ONLY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Enable read-only mode to restrict write operations

environmentVariables.name: DRY_RUN_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Write tools return the request they would send instead of changing GLPI

environmentVariables.name: DISABLED_TAGS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of tags to disable tools for

environmentVariables.name: RESPONSE_MAX_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Maximum size of a tool response in bytes (empty = unlimited)

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Logging level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL)

environmentVariables.name: RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Enable rate limiting

environmentVariables.name: RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum requests per rate limit window

environmentVariables.name: RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MINUTES
environmentVariables.description: Rate limit window in minutes

environmentVariables.name: TOOL_SEARCH_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Enable FastMCP tool search transform

environmentVariables.name: TOOL_SEARCH_STRATEGY
environmentVariables.description: Tool search strategy (bm25 or regex)

environmentVariables.name: TOOL_SEARCH_MAX_RESULTS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum tool search results returned by search_tools
